source: # Placeholder so the nav link works. Skip if you already have one.
# US:04 Makes sure only members can sign in for individual events
# AC-03.4: User stays logged in across refreshes/reopening
redirect_to root_path, alert: "Please sign in with your TAMU email to continue."
# redirect to edit profile if UIN is missing
redirect_to edit_member_path(current_member), alert: "Please complete your profile details to proceed."
# AC-04.1: check-in page only opens for active events
# AC-04.2: @attendance tells the view whether the member already checked in
return redirect_to(root_path, alert: "#{@event.event_name} isn't open for check-in yet.") unless @event.active?
# AC-04.1: records the member's attendance; points come from Member#total_points
# AC-04.2: find_or_create_by! means a second check-in never creates a duplicate
# Never trust the button: re-check on the server
return render json: { error: "This event isn't open for check-in yet." }, status: :unprocessable_entity
render json: { checked_in: true, check_in_time: attendance.check_in_time }
# Double-tap race: the other request already saved it
render json: { error: "Set up your member profile first." }, status: :forbidden
redirect_to new_member_path, alert: "Set up your member profile before checking in."
# Old dashboard replaced by the home page (points + events live there now)
# AC-05.6: list events; active ones are clickable, future ones greyed out
# AC-05.1 / AC-05.3: current point total (0 for a new member)
# AC-01.2: Deny non-TAMU emails with an explicit error message
redirect_to root_path, alert: "Access denied: You must use an official @tamu.edu email address."
session[:user_id] = user.id # AC-03.1 & AC-03.4: Maintain logged-in session
# redirect to edit profile if UIN is missing
redirect_to edit_member_path(member), notice: "Please complete your profile by providing your UIN and Class Year."
redirect_to dashboard_path, notice: "Successfully signed in!" # AC-01.3
redirect_to root_path, alert: "Failed to sign in using Google."
# AC-03.2: Log out and terminate session
# AC-01.5: Return user to login on OAuth cancellation without creating partial account
redirect_to root_path, alert: "Sign-in was canceled or failed. Please try again."
# AC-05.5: blank profile fields show "Not Provided"
# Automatically retry jobs that encountered a deadlock
# Most jobs are safe to ignore if the underlying records are no longer available
# AC-04.1 / AC-05.6: an event is "active" (check-in allowed) once it has started

validates :uin, presence: { message: "cannot be blank" }, numericality: { only_integer: true, message: "must be numeric " }, length: { is: 9, message: "must be exactly 9 digits" }, uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false }, on: :update
validates :class_year, presence: { message: "cannot be blank" }, numericality: { only_integer: true, greater_than: 2000, less_than: 2100, message: "must be a valid 4-digit year" }, on: :update
# Point total = sum of point values for every event this member checked into.
# Calculated live from attendances, so a new check-in counts right away,
# and a member with no check-ins gets 0.
# AC-01.4: Find existing user by email instead of creating duplicate accounts
# Update attributes in case provider info was missing
user.update(uid: uid, provider: provider, full_name: full_name) if user.persisted?
errors.add(:email, "must be an official TAMU email (@tamu.edu)")
